exposure: second-trimester Uterine Artery (UtA) Doppler indices (pulsatility index, resistance index, systolic/diastolic ratio)
cohort: Healthy pregnant women aged 18 to 45 years old were recruited and divided into groups with and without prior cesarean delivery.
finding: Uterine Artery Resistance Index (UtA-RI) was higher in participants with prior cesarean delivery compared to those without, but this was not associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
gest_age: UtA Doppler study performed between 18 to 24 weeks of gestation; mean gestational age at delivery was 38.41 weeks.
